digest.component_or_area: review-bot deployment and persistent tickets clone management
propositions: The review-bot's persistent tickets clone on EBS-backed external volume does not refresh during normal redeploy because the generated entrypoint clones only when .git is absent, preserving divergent history.

The ensure-tickets.sh script must run convergence outside the PAT block even when REVIEWBOT_TICKETS_PAT is unset, and currently lacks fetching, ancestry classification, and reset logic for divergent persistent clones.

A fetch with explicit refspec +refs/heads/tickets:refs/remotes/origin/tickets must advance the remote-tracking ref for the classifier; if credentials are absent or origin unreachable, preserve local tip and emit warning without aborting already-cast votes.

Pre-epoch local clones whose local tip is an ancestor of a readable prior remote tip must adopt the pinned newly fetched epoch-bearing remote commit only when compatible; all other states must preserve the local tip exactly.

The autodeploy.sh BOT_PATHS omits reviewbot-ensure-tickets.sh, preventing deploy changes to this script from reaching the box; the script must be added to BOT_PATHS so future ensure-script changes self-deploy.

Convergence must use rebar._store.sync.reconverge for compatible equal/behind/ahead/same-epoch divergent histories to preserve local-only commits and maintain the union safety invariant, with a narrow adoption path for pre-epoch-to-epoch reclaim only under strict preconditions.
